meta.title: 在云南景迈山给女朋友拍的写真！｜X2DII
meta.title_en: A Portrait Shoot for My Girlfriend on Jingmai Mountain! | X2DII
meta.topic: 摄影Vlog · 云南景迈山写真

scenes.title_cn: 开场：景迈山写真拍摄现场
scenes.title_en: Opening: A Portrait Shoot on Jingmai Mountain
scenes.context: 博主龚醒来到云南景迈山给女朋友拍写真，到得比较晚，只有两小时天黑前的时间，相当于提前踩点。语域：拍摄现场口播，紧凑兴奋。
sentences: 这期女拍我们来到云南景迈山。
For this portrait shoot, we've come to Jingmai Mountain in Yunnan.
a portrait shoot（写真拍摄）；come to（来到）
我们今天到的时间太晚了，现在已经是六点半了。
We got here too late today — it's already 6:30.
get here（到达）；already（已经）
它这边是八点半左右天黑，所以我们还有大概两个小时的时间。
It gets dark around 8:30 here, so we still have about two hours.
it gets dark（天黑）；about two hours（大概两小时）
paraphrase: 拍写真 → take portrait photos / do a portrait shoot
portrait · portrait shoot
踩点 → scout the location / check out the spot
scout · check out
scenes.speak: For this portrait shoot, we've come to Jingmai Mountain in Yunnan. We got here too late today — it's already 6:30. It gets dark around 8:30 here, so we still have about two hours.

scenes.title_cn: X2D2 连续自动对焦抓拍
scenes.title_en: X2DII Continuous Autofocus for Candid Shots
scenes.context: 这次用哈苏 X2DII 搭配 55V 镜头，博主说它有连续自动对焦，可以抓拍走路的动态瞬间。语域：拍摄指导，现场指令。
sentences: 这次我们用到X2DII搭配这个55V。
This time we're using the X2DII with the 55V lens.
pair with（搭配）；the 55V lens
X2DII是有连续自动对焦的，可以抓拍一下。
The X2DII has continuous autofocus, so we can grab some candid shots.
continuous autofocus（连续自动对焦）；candid shots（抓拍）
你往上走吧，我这个台阶沿着上面走。
Walk up the steps — I'll follow you from the stairs.
walk up（往上走）；follow you（跟着你）
paraphrase: 连续自动对焦 → continuous autofocus / tracking focus
autofocus · tracking focus
抓拍 → grab candid shots / capture a moment
candid shots · capture a moment
scenes.speak: This time we're using the X2DII with the 55V lens. The X2DII has continuous autofocus, so we can grab some candid shots. Walk up the steps — I'll follow you from the stairs.

scenes.title_cn: 服装店百合花：店家热情借拍
scenes.title_en: Lilies in a Clothing Shop: The Owner Lends Them
scenes.context: 逛到服装店门口被百合花吸引，原本以为可租可卖，店家说不卖但很热情地借给拍照。语域：记录对话，感激语气。
sentences: 逛到一家服装店门口，我们被这里的百合花吸引住了。
We strolled past a clothing shop and were drawn in by the lilies here.
be drawn in by（被…吸引住）；lilies（百合花）
虽然店家说不卖，但还是很热情地说可以借给我们拍照。
The owner said they're not for sale, but was kind enough to let us borrow them for the shoot.
not for sale（不卖）；let us borrow（借给我们）
好香啊，超级香。
So fragrant — unbelievably fragrant.
fragrant（香的）；unbelievably（超级地）
paraphrase: 被吸引住 → be drawn in by / can't take your eyes off
drawn in · can't take your eyes off
借给我们 → let us borrow / lend them to us
borrow · lend
scenes.speak: We strolled past a clothing shop and were drawn in by the lilies here. The owner said they're not for sale, but was kind enough to let us borrow them for the shoot. So fragrant — unbelievably fragrant.

scenes.title_cn: 捡垃圾文学：塑料袋也能当道具
scenes.title_en: Trash-Picking Aesthetics: Even a Plastic Bag Works
scenes.context: 博主自嘲是「捡垃圾」摄影师：地上捡的塑料袋、路边的花都是道具，还调侃大家不要随手扔垃圾，便宜了自己这种人。语域：幽默自嘲，摄影理念。
sentences: 你看我是不是捡了一个塑料袋，我捡的塑料袋和这个花也是垃圾。
See, I picked up a plastic bag — the bag and these flowers I found are both junk.
pick up（捡起）；junk（垃圾）
我们这一段就叫捡垃圾。
This whole segment is called trash-picking.
trash-picking（捡垃圾）
你看不要随手扔垃圾，就便宜了我这种人吧。
Don't throw litter around, or you'll just be doing people like me a favor.
throw litter（随手扔垃圾）；do me a favor（便宜我）
paraphrase: 捡垃圾 → trash-picking / hunting for props
trash-picking · hunting for props
便宜了我 → do me a favor / work in my favor
do me a favor · in my favor
scenes.speak: See, I picked up a plastic bag — the bag and these flowers I found are both junk. This whole segment is called trash-picking. Don't throw litter around, or you'll just be doing people like me a favor.

scenes.title_en: A Rainy Day Beats a Cloudy Spring Day
scenes.context: 天气不理想，但博主说下雨天总比阴天好。在诺干古寨借到背篓和花做道具，旅拍店老板阿宏是频道观众，热情提供灵感。语域：随遇而安，记录拍摄过程。
sentences: 今天天气不是很理想，但是下雨天总比春阴天好。
The weather isn't ideal today, but a rainy day is still better than an overcast spring day.
overcast（阴天的）；not ideal（不理想）
非常有缘分的是，这家旅拍店的阿宏是我们频道的观众。
What a coincidence — Ahong, who runs this photo shop, is a subscriber to our channel.
what a coincidence（真有缘分）；a subscriber（观众、订阅者）
他不但很热情地借给我们拍摄道具，还给我们提供了拍摄灵感。
Not only did he lend us props enthusiastically, he also gave us shooting ideas.
lend us props（借给我们道具）；give us ideas（提供灵感）
paraphrase: 真有缘分 → what a coincidence / what a lucky find
coincidence · lucky find
提供灵感 → give us ideas / spark some inspiration
give ideas · spark inspiration
scenes.speak: The weather isn't ideal today, but a rainy day is still better than an overcast spring day. What a coincidence — Ahong, who runs this photo shop, is a subscriber to our channel. Not only did he lend us props enthusiastically, he also gave us shooting ideas.

scenes.context: 来到翁基古寨的佛寺，这是「生活的佛寺」，博主给女朋友设定剧情：在山上采了草药下山去卖换钱。青苔遍布，很有质感。语域：创作拍摄，故事化表达。
sentences: 楼梯这里往上走是一个寺庙，这是生活的佛寺。
Up the stairs is a temple — a lived-in temple.
a lived-in temple（有生活气息的佛寺）
我已经想好了剧情，我是在山上采的草药，然后下山去卖换钱。
I've already planned the story — she gathered herbs on the mountain and comes down to sell them for money.
gather herbs（采草药）；sell for money（卖钱换钱）
这个寨子比诺干会更商业化一些。
This village is a bit more commercialized than Nuogan.
commercialized（商业化）；a bit more（更…一些）
paraphrase: 有生活气息 → lived-in / full of everyday life
lived-in · everyday life
想好剧情 → plan the story / set up a little narrative
plan the story · narrative
scenes.speak: Up the stairs is a temple — a lived-in temple. I've already planned the story — she gathered herbs on the mountain and comes down to sell them for money. This village is a bit more commercialized than Nuogan.

scenes.context: 环境比较乱的地方可以利用长焦压缩视角，让画面更干净；不够就加点魔法。青苔的感觉很好看，博主还发现了一只蜜蜂。语域：摄影技巧分享，现场指导。
sentences: 环境比较乱的地方，我们可以利用到长焦去压缩视角，这样会相对干净一些。
In messy environments, we can use a telephoto lens to compress the perspective and keep the shot cleaner.
compress the perspective（压缩视角）；telephoto lens（长焦镜头）
如果还不够，那就加点魔法。
And if that's still not enough, just add a little magic.
add a little magic（加点魔法）
这青苔的感觉，挺好看的。
This mossy texture looks really nice.
mossy texture（青苔质感）
paraphrase: 压缩视角 → compress the perspective / flatten the composition
compress the perspective · flatten
青苔质感 → mossy texture / moss-covered feel
mossy · moss-covered
scenes.speak: In messy environments, we can use a telephoto lens to compress the perspective and keep the shot cleaner. And if that's still not enough, just add a little magic. This mossy texture looks really nice.

scenes.context: 拍摄接近尾声，博主用倒影/镜像构图收尾。这一趟景迈山拍摄之旅就从这个倒影结束，他觉得很有意思，期待下期再见。语域：收尾总结，轻松道别。
sentences: 你在拍我，在照镜子，我突然发现一张丑脸在这里。
You're photographing me, looking in the mirror — I suddenly spotted an ugly face here.
look in the mirror（照镜子）；spot（发现）
这一趟的景迈山拍摄之旅，就从这个倒影结束吧。
Let's end this Jingmai Mountain shoot with this reflection.
a reflection（倒影）；end with（以…结束）
我觉得挺有意思的，希望你喜欢，那我们下期视频再见。
I found it really fun — I hope you enjoyed it. See you in the next video.
hope you enjoy（希望你喜欢）；see you in the next video（下期再见）
paraphrase: 镜像构图 → mirror-symmetry composition / shoot through the reflection
mirror-symmetry · reflection
以…收尾 → end with / wrap up with
end with · wrap up with
scenes.speak: You're photographing me, looking in the mirror — I suddenly spotted an ugly face here. Let's end this Jingmai Mountain shoot with this reflection. I found it really fun — I hope you enjoyed it. See you in the next video.

practice: These lilies are so fragrant — unbelievably fragrant.
In a messy scene, a telephoto lens compresses the perspective and keeps it clean.
What a coincidence — the shop owner is a subscriber to our channel!
I hope you enjoyed this one — see you in the next video!
pitfalls: The X2D2 has continuous focus auto.
autofocus 是一个词（自动对焦），不能说 focus auto；形容词 continuous 修饰名词 autofocus。
The owner says it don't sell.
The owner said they're not for sale.
be not for sale 是固定表达「不卖」；it don't sell 语法与语义都不对。
I picked up a plastic bag from the ground.
pick up（捡起）与 pick（挑选）含义不同；从地上捡要用 pick up。
The weather is not very ideal.
not very ideal 中的 very 冗余；直接说 not ideal 更地道。
shifts: 用 nice、pretty、fun、interesting 表达不同层次
说天气不好只会 bad weather
用 overcast（阴天）、not ideal（不理想）、rainy（下雨）更精准
用 pick up（捡起）、gather（采集）、find（发现）区分动作
footer_notes: ASR 专有名词已校正：龚醒→龚醒、锦麦山/锦迈山→景迈山、OO特→Outfit、55V→55V、诺甘/诺干→诺干古寨、汪鸡/翁基→翁基古寨、X2DII/X2D2→X2DII、背楼→背篓、珠草→珠草、旅拍店阿宏→阿宏等。
